conventions.convention: V is C² with ordered basis e₁,e₂; tensor products are over C and tensor powers are left-associated. Products of endomorphisms apply the rightmost factor first.
P flips tensor factors, R(u)=uI+iP, and the checked operator is PR(u)=uP+iI. This definition asserts no universal Hopf R-matrix or categorical braiding.
The spectral differences are u=x−y, v=y−z, and w=x−z=u+v; both identities hold for arbitrary complex spectral points without an invertibility hypothesis.
The rank-one Hecke relation is (T−q)(T+q⁻¹)=0. Rescaling S=qT gives multiplicative parameter ξ=q². Semisimplicity means that the left regular module is a direct sum of simple left ideals.

load_bearing.statement: For V=C², define the flip P on basis tensors and set R(u)=uI+iP and checked R(u)=PR(u)=uP+iI. On V⊗³, P₁₂,P₁₃,P₂₃ swap the indicated tensor positions, and Rᵢⱼ(u)=uI+iPᵢⱼ.
For arbitrary x,y,z∈C, set u=x−y, v=y−z, and w=x−z=u+v. Then R₁₂(u)R₁₃(w)R₂₃(v)=R₂₃(v)R₁₃(w)R₁₂(u), and checked R₁(u) checked R₂(w) checked R₁(v)=checked R₂(v) checked R₁(w) checked R₂(u).
